tasks.title: Write Dockerfile to containerize the React/Vite app
tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile at the project root (/Users/one-don/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/Dockerfile). The project is a React 18 + TypeScript app built with Vite (package manager: npm). Use a multi-stage build: Stage 1 — use node:18-alpine as builder, set WORKDIR /app, copy package.json and package-lock.json, run `npm ci`, copy the rest of the source, run `npm run build` (which executes `tsc && vite build` per package.json). Stage 2 — use nginx:alpine as the final image, copy the built dist/ folder from the builder stage to /usr/share/nginx/html, expose port 80, and set CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]. The vite.config.ts confirms the dev server runs on port 5173, but for the container the built static assets should be served by nginx on port 80. Do not add a .dockerignore yet (only create Dockerfile). No tests are needed for this infrastructure file.
acceptance_criteria: Uses multi-stage build: node:18-alpine builder stage and nginx:alpine serve stage
Builder stage runs `npm ci` then `npm run build`
Final stage copies dist/ from builder to /usr/share/nginx/html

tasks.title: Validate Dockerfile exists and is well-formed
tasks.description: Verify the Dockerfile at the project root exists and contains the expected multi-stage build instructions. Read the file and confirm: (1) it has a FROM node:18-alpine builder stage, (2) it runs npm ci and npm run build, (3) it has a FROM nginx:alpine final stage, (4) it copies dist/ to /usr/share/nginx/html, (5) it exposes port 80, (6) CMD is set to run nginx. If Docker is available, optionally run `docker build -t eunomia-mini-calculator .` from the project root to confirm the image builds without errors.
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile is present at project root
All required directives (FROM, WORKDIR, COPY, RUN, EXPOSE, CMD) are present and correct
